population_validation: Canonical metadata verifies all studies in train folds 0/1/2 with no validation/test overlap. All 141 outcome-specific sample counts match maximal production counts; lab-model populations can be smaller.
estimator: Unchanged original fit_isolated_model method: unpenalized logistic regression, Fisher-information Wald confidence intervals and p-values.
normalization: Full Discovery mean and population SD (ddof=0), before outcome masking; OR per SD.
multiple_testing_note: Clinical tests corrected over the 604185 original tests plus 705 new tests. Frozen concept estimates retain their original correction.
payload: Aggregate effects, counts and normalization parameters; no patient records, identifiers or activations.
sex_coding: 1 = male; 0 = female or unknown, matching canonical cohort encoding.
